aiCommit.config.diffSource.description: Which git changes to use for generation: auto (prefer staged, fallback to unstaged), staged, unstaged, or staged+unstaged.
aiCommit.config.referenceGitLog.descript: Send recent commit subjects (git log --oneline) to the selected AI provider as style context. Enabled by default.
aiCommit.config.gitLogCount.description: How many recent commits to include from git log (max 50).
aiCommit.config.gitLogAuthorScope.descri: Which authors' commits to include in git log context.
aiCommit.config.azureApiVersion.descript: AZURE API VERSION (leave empty if not using Azure)
aiCommit.config.openaiBaseUrl.descriptio:
OpenAI Base URL. Uses the official endpoint by default. For Azure OpenAI, use your deployments URL and configure `ai-commit.AZURE_API_VERSION`.

Click here ➡️ [Set OpenAI API Key](command:ai-commit.setOpenAIApiKey). The key is stored securely in VS Code SecretStorage.
aiCommit.config.openaiModel.description: OpenAI MODEL, you can select a model from the list by running the 'Show Available OpenAI Models' command
aiCommit.config.systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for generating commit messages
aiCommit.config.scmInputBehavior.descrip: When generating with AI, how to use the commit message input box.
aiCommit.config.scmInputBehavior.enum.co: Use the input box content as additional context/constraints (for example, if you want the AI-generated commit message to include a Bug ID, you can first enter the Bug ID in the input box, and the AI will generate content based on the entered information).
aiCommit.config.openaiTemperature.descri: Optional OpenAI temperature setting (0-2). It is omitted by default and ignored for GPT-5 and o-series reasoning models.
aiCommit.config.aiProvider.description: AI Provider to use (OpenAI, Gemini, or Anthropic).
aiCommit.config.geminiBaseUrl.descriptio:
Gemini Base URL. Uses the official endpoint by default. Change it when using a proxy or third-party provider.

Click here ➡️ [Set Gemini API Key](command:ai-commit.setGeminiApiKey). The key is stored securely in VS Code SecretStorage.
aiCommit.configuration.anthropic.title: Anthropic
aiCommit.command.setAnthropicApiKey.titl: Nota AI Commit: Set Anthropic API Key
aiCommit.command.clearAnthropicApiKey.ti: Nota AI Commit: Clear Anthropic API Key
aiCommit.config.anthropicBaseUrl.descrip:
Anthropic Messages API Base URL, including /v1 (do not include /messages). Uses the official endpoint by default; change it for an Anthropic-compatible provider.

Click here ➡️ [Set Anthropic API Key](command:ai-commit.setAnthropicApiKey). The key is stored securely in VS Code SecretStorage.
aiCommit.config.anthropicModel.descripti: Anthropic model ID. For third-party providers, use their model ID.
aiCommit.config.anthropicMaxTokens.descr: Maximum output tokens for Anthropic. Increase this if the response is truncated, within the model output limit.
